name: PhotoRoom
freeTierNote: Limited features/exports for personal non-commercial use.
bestFor: Catalog photos, marketplace listings, and background removal that has to finish today
skipIf: You are making art, not product shots
keyFeatures: Clean subject cutouts for e-commerce SKUs
Batch studio backgrounds for product catalogs
limitations: Built for product shots, not imaginative illustration
summary: A boring, profitable job: cut the subject out and put it on a clean background. Does that job well.
body: PhotoRoom (and Remove.bg-class tools) print money because shops need 400 SKU photos, not a fantasy illustration. If your “AI image” article skips this category, it is written for Twitter, not for sellers. The free tier covers personal non-commercial use; Pro unlocks batch exports and commercial workflows.
notes: Batch credits are the paid feature
Keep original files; marketplaces change background rules
Not a generator of novel scenes
